parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main structural body of the microwave, made of stainless steel for durability and heat resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, houses internal components, and ensures electromagnetic shielding during operation.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door is a front panel made of tempered glass with a handle, allowing users to access the cooking chamber.
parts.Functional_description: It opens and closes to allow food placement and removal, and seals the microwave cavity to prevent radiation leakage.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about a hinge on one side, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side controls are a plastic interface panel located on the side of the microwave front.
parts.Functional_description: They allow users to set cooking time, power level, and other functions through buttons or a touchpad.
parts.Movement_description: The control buttons or dials can be pressed or rotated, while the panel itself remains stationary.
